protocol.name: current_exact_split_model_family_baselines_v1
protocol.comparison_scope: same current source-grouped fixed internal-test support
protocol.vlm_baseline_role: unchanged raw v6 paired cross-attention under the existing 50% sparse-note protocol; the post-hoc text_image_fusion class gate is reported only as a diagnostic

late_probability_fusion_diagnostic.reason: The existing ViT specialist artifact stores hard predictions but not validation/test probability scores. A probability-fusion diagnostic would require rerunning the separate ViT feature pipeline and is intentionally omitted.

protocol.evidence_boundary: internal development test previously observed during protocol development; not fresh external or category-best evidence

text_only_llm.architecture: distilbert-base-uncased frozen encoder, deterministic 50% sparse-note attention mask, masked-mean 768-d embedding, validation-selected class-weighted ridge

image_only_vit.architecture: WinKawaks/vit-tiny-patch16-224 frozen CLS embeddings; ridge classifier selected on validation

image_text_vlm.architecture: unchanged validation-selected v6 paired bidirectional cross-attention output under deterministic 50% sparse notes; no post-hoc class gate

proposed_farmfederate.architecture: unchanged v6 ResNet-50 + text Transformer + bidirectional cross-attention core with the existing validation-selected reliability-aware proposed_multimodal router

text_only_llm.tie_break: macro_f1, accuracy, representation order, alpha near 1, class-weight power near 0.5

image_text_vlm.checkpoint_role: unchanged validation-selected v6 raw paired cross-attention output

late_fusion_vlm.architecture: existing validation-selected class gate over raw v6 cross-attention and the enhanced image expert
